newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbian journalists demand minister's resignation.
newsitem.headline: Serbian journalists demand minister's resignation.

text.p: The Serbian journalists' association demanded the resignation of republic's interior minister over police attacks on reporters in Belgrade, the Belgrade-based news agency BETA said on Monday.

The non-government Independent Association of Journalists of Serbia demanded that Interior Minister Zoran Sokolovic resign after security police attacked protesters on Sunday, injuring more than 100 in the bloodiest political violence seen for years in Belgrade.

"In the most brutal and bestial attack by the police on the peaceful demonstrators in Belgrade, among whom there were children, students, and elderly people, dozens of local and foreign journalists and cameramen were also injured," the association's statement was quoted as saying.
"The reporters had their films confiscated, their cameras smashed, they were beaten up and stamped on."
Serbia's anti-riot police and demonstrators, demonstrating for the 77th day to back demands for democratic reforms, clashed on Sunday, drawing condemnation from Western countries.
Belgrade students have demanded that President Slobodan Milosevic withdraw the police and punish those who ordered the violence.
